question: Should selected Discord role mentions be an opt-in wake signal, and should the permanent contract use explicit configured role IDs rather than automatically treating every role held by the bot as addressed?
rationale: The change deliberately affects multi-agent fan-out and adds compatibility-sensitive configuration; source evidence establishes feasibility but cannot choose the permanent product policy.

options.title: Explicit role IDs
options.body: Add a separate per-guild/per-channel opt-in list of role IDs that count as wake mentions while leaving sender-role authorization unchanged.

options.title: Infer bot roles
options.body: Treat any mentioned role held by the bot as a wake signal, reducing setup but broadening triggers and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Keep direct mentions
options.body: Retain current wake semantics and require users to mention each bot individually.

recommendation.title: Explicit role IDs
recommendation.body: Add a separate per-guild/per-channel opt-in list of role IDs that count as wake mentions while leaving sender-role authorization unchanged.
